# Founders Committee Ventures

> Pre-seed venture capital syndicate backing technical founders and engineers.

Founders Committee Ventures (FCV) writes $25K–$150K checks into pre-seed and seed-stage
B2B SaaS and deep tech companies founded by engineers, scientists, and developers.
We are a syndicate of technical founders and operators who provide deep engineering
due diligence and hands-on operational support from pre-seed to Series A.

## Portfolio
- [Select Portfolio](https://fcv.vc/#portfolio): 13+ portfolio companies, 3 exits

## Team
- [Our Partners](https://fcv.vc/#team): 7 partners — technical founders and operators
